patch.summary: Edit a guest's displayname and/or Instagram handle
patch.description:
Edit a guest's displayname and/or instagram_username.

A key omitted from the request body is left untouched. A key sent
explicitly as null clears it - but only for instagram_username.
displayname is typed str | None on the request schema, so the schema
itself accepts {"displayname": null} without a 422; it is this
function's own guard (payload.displayname is not None) that silently
ignores an explicit null for displayname instead of clearing it,
because Guest.displayname is non-nullable and cannot actually be
cleared. This distinction uses payload.model_fields_set, since
payload.instagram_username is None in both the "omitted" and
"explicitly cleared" cases.

mazmo_user_id and mazmo_handle cannot be changed here - use
link-mazmo/unlink-mazmo for that. This is a cosmetic edit, not an
audited business event, so no event_log entry is written.

get.summary: Ping
Check health of all dependencies
get.description:
Comprehensive health check that verifies connectivity to:
- **Database**: Critical - app cannot function without it
- **Mazmo API**: Non-critical - app works but can't sync new guests

Returns HTTP 200 if all critical services are healthy.
Returns HTTP 503 if any critical service is unhealthy.

The response body includes individual service status and latency.

503.description: One or more critical services unhealthy

head.summary: Health check (no body) — used by UptimeRobot
head.description:
Same health logic as `GET /health` but returns no response body, as required
by RFC 9110 for HEAD requests.

**Used by UptimeRobot** for uptime monitoring. UptimeRobot sends HEAD
requests to avoid downloading the response body on every check. Returns
200 if healthy, 503 if any critical service is down.

503.description: One or more critical services unhealthy

AddOrgMemberRequest.title: AddOrgMemberRequest
AddOrgMemberRequest.description: Request body to add a user to an organization.

ApproveUserRequest.title: ApproveUserRequest
ApproveUserRequest.description:
Request body for approving or revoking a user's access.

Admins use this to flip the is_approved flag on staff accounts.
New registrations start unapproved and require admin action.

BanGuestRequest.title: BanGuestRequest
BanGuestRequest.description: Request body for banning a guest within an organization.

BannedGuestListResponse.title: BannedGuestListResponse
BannedGuestListResponse.description: Response for listing all banned guests in an organization.

BannedGuestPublic.title: BannedGuestPublic
BannedGuestPublic.description:
Guest info with ban details, sourced from organization_bans.

Used in the org-scoped banned guests list endpoint.

CheckInResponse.title: CheckInResponse
CheckInResponse.description: Response after successfully checking in a guest.

CheckedInByPublic.title: CheckedInByPublic
CheckedInByPublic.description: Minimal staff representation for check-in attribution.

CreateGuestRequest.title: CreateGuestRequest
CreateGuestRequest.description: Request body for creating a guest by Mazmo username (POST /guests/mazmo).

CreateManualGuestRequest.title: CreateManualGuestRequest
CreateManualGuestRequest.description: Request body for creating a guest without a Mazmo account (POST /guests/manual).

DisableUserRequest.title: DisableUserRequest
DisableUserRequest.description:
Request body for disabling a staff account.

A reason is required for audit trail purposes. Disabled accounts
cannot log in but their data is preserved for historical reference.

EventActorPublic.title: EventActorPublic
EventActorPublic.description:
Minimal staff representation in event logs.

Shows who performed an action without exposing sensitive account details.

EventGuestPublic.title: EventGuestPublic
EventGuestPublic.description:
Minimal guest representation in event logs.

Provides enough info to identify the guest without full profile data.

EventLogListResponse.title: EventLogListResponse
EventLogListResponse.description:
Paginated list of event log entries.

Pagination fields:
  - total: Total number of events matching the filter (for UI pagination)
  - limit: Maximum events per page (default 50, max 100)
  - offset: Number of events skipped (for page calculation)

Example: Page 2 with 50 per page → offset=50, limit=50

EventLogPublic.title: EventLogPublic
EventLogPublic.description:
Single event log entry for API responses.

Contains the full context of what happened: who did what to whom,
when, and why. Relationships are expanded for convenience.

Fields:
  - id: Unique event identifier
  - event_type: What happened (see EventType in app/models/models.py for the full list)
  - timestamp: When it happened (UTC)
  - actor: Staff member who performed the action
  - guest: Guest who was affected (if applicable)
  - meetup_id: Related meetup UUID (for check-in events)
  - reason: Why the action was taken (required for bans, optional for undos)

GuestListResponse.title: GuestListResponse
GuestListResponse.description:
Response for listing all known guests (global, no org context).

Returns identity-only data. For RSVP state at a specific meetup,
use the /organizations/{org_id}/meetups/{id}/guests endpoint instead.

GuestPublic.title: GuestPublic
GuestPublic.description:
A guest's identity (cached locally, may or may not have a Mazmo account).

Identity-only - no RSVP or ban state. Bans are per-org and are
included only in org-scoped endpoints via GuestWithBanPublic.

GuestType.title: GuestType
GuestType.description:
Category of a guest's attendance at a specific meetup.

NORMAL guests are subject to the meetup's requires_payment flag like
any regular attendee. INVITED, VENDOR, and STAFF guests are exempt
from the payment check-in gate regardless of has_paid: invited guests
were personally invited by the meetup organizer and don't pay entry,
vendors bring their own stand to sell goods and aren't attending as
participants, and staff are working the event itself. This is set
per-RSVP (not on the Guest) because these categories are decided
event by event, not a persistent trait of the person.

GuestTypeUpdateRequest.title: GuestTypeUpdateRequest
GuestTypeUpdateRequest.description: Request body for changing a guest's category at a specific meetup.

GuestWithBanPublic.title: GuestWithBanPublic
GuestWithBanPublic.description:
Guest identity with org-scoped ban status.

Used in meetup guest lists and org-specific guest endpoints where
the frontend needs to know if this guest is banned in the current org.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
Full health check response.

The overall status is "healthy" only if all critical services are healthy.
Non-critical services being down results in "degraded" status.

LinkMazmoRequest.title: LinkMazmoRequest
LinkMazmoRequest.description: Request body for linking an existing guest to a Mazmo account.

MeetupCreate.title: MeetupCreate
MeetupCreate.description:
Request body for creating a new meetup.

The mazmo_meetup_url is validated to match the expected Mazmo format.
During creation, the API calls Mazmo to fetch the event date, which
also verifies the URL points to a real event.

MeetupGuestListResponse.title: MeetupGuestListResponse
MeetupGuestListResponse.description: Response for listing guests at a specific meetup.

MeetupGuestPublic.title: MeetupGuestPublic
MeetupGuestPublic.description:
Combined view of a guest at a specific meetup.

guest includes ban status for this org (is_banned) so the frontend
can render warnings at the door.

MeetupListResponse.title: MeetupListResponse
MeetupListResponse.description:
Response for listing all meetups.

Returns meetups ordered by date descending (most recent first).

MeetupPublic.title: MeetupPublic
MeetupPublic.description:
Public representation of a meetup.

Returned when fetching meetup details. The mazmo_meetup_url is the
source URL used for syncing RSVPs from the Mazmo platform.

OrgCreate.title: OrgCreate
OrgCreate.description: Request body to create a new organization.

OrgMemberPublic.title: OrgMemberPublic
OrgMemberPublic.description: A user's membership in an organization.

OrgMembershipPublic.title: OrgMembershipPublic
OrgMembershipPublic.description: A user's membership in an org, flattened for the userinfo response.

OrgUpdate.title: OrgUpdate
OrgUpdate.description: Request body to partially update an organization's name and/or slug.

PaymentResponse.title: PaymentResponse
PaymentResponse.description: Response after successfully marking a guest's entrance as paid.

PossibleRoles.title: PossibleRoles
PossibleRoles.description:
Global roles stored in user_roles / users.role_id.

USER:       Regular approved account. Actual capabilities come from
            user_organizations.role (per-org STAFF or ADMIN).
SITE_ADMIN: Superadmin. Bypasses all org membership checks, can create
            and manage organizations.

RolePublic.title: RolePublic
RolePublic.description:
Public representation of a user role.

Used when returning user data that includes their role information.
Maps directly to the Role model via from_attributes.

RoleRequest.title: RoleRequest
RoleRequest.description:
Request body for changing a user's role.

Used by admins to promote staff to admin or demote admins to staff.

RsvpPublic.title: RsvpPublic
RsvpPublic.description:
Event-specific RSVP state for a guest at a meetup.

arrival_time and arrival_order are set by a database trigger when
has_arrived flips to True during check-in. guest_type defaults to
NORMAL and is only ever changed via PATCH .../guests/{id}/type.

ServiceCheck.title: ServiceCheck
ServiceCheck.description: Result of a single service health check.

ServiceStatus.title: ServiceStatus
ServiceStatus.description: Status of an individual service check.

StaffRegisterRequest.title: StaffRegisterRequest
StaffRegisterRequest.description:
Request body for staff registration.

Strict mode ensures exact type matching - no coercion from strings to ints, etc.
Password has a minimum length of 15 characters for security.

SyncResponse.title: SyncResponse
SyncResponse.description:
Response after syncing guests from Mazmo.

Reports how many new guests/RSVPs were inserted vs already existed.
The sync is idempotent - running it multiple times is safe.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
Response returned after successful authentication.

Contains the JWT access token that the client should include in
subsequent requests via the Authorization header.

UndoCheckInRequest.title: UndoCheckInRequest
UndoCheckInRequest.description: Request body for undoing a check-in.

UndoPaymentRequest.title: UndoPaymentRequest
UndoPaymentRequest.description: Request body for undoing a payment mark.

UpdateGuestRequest.title: UpdateGuestRequest
UpdateGuestRequest.description:
Request body for editing a guest's displayname and/or Instagram handle.

Both fields are optional (partial update). Whether an omitted key
means "don't touch" vs. an explicit null meaning "clear it" is
resolved by the router via payload.model_fields_set, not by this
schema - see update_guest() in app/routers/guests.py.

UserPublic.title: UserPublic
UserPublic.description:
Public representation of a staff user.

Returned when fetching user details. Includes the nested role object
for convenience. Never includes the hashed password.

UserSearchResult.title: UserSearchResult
UserSearchResult.description: Minimal user info returned by the search endpoint.

tags.name: organizations

tags.name: staff
tags.description: Staff and admin management. List, approve, disable, and manage roles for staff accounts. Most operations require SITE_ADMIN privileges.

tags.name: guests

tags.name: meetups
tags.description: Meetup operations. Create meetups, sync guest lists from Mazmo, view RSVPs, and perform check-ins. Requires approved staff access.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Audit event log. These are internal system events logged for auditing, not to be confused with Mazmo 'eventos' (meetups).

tags.name: users
tags.description: User search. Search active users by username to add them to organizations.

tags.name: meta
tags.description: Service metadata endpoints: health checks, root info, and ping.
